steps.en: Install the desktop build (or just open the hosted editor in a browser)
steps.zh: 装桌面版（或直接在浏览器开托管编辑器）

steps.en: Runs the entire editor locally as an Electron app; no diagram data leaves the machine
steps.zh: 整个编辑器本地跑（Electron），图数据不外传

steps.en: Draw shapes and connections, pulling icons from the built-in shape libraries
steps.zh: 在画布上拖形状、连关系，图标从内置库取

steps.en: Writes every element as an mxCell — geometry plus a style string — inside mxGraph XML
steps.zh: 把每个元素写成 mxCell：几何加一条 style 串

steps.en: Save the .drawio file (plain-text XML) or export a picture for the document
steps.zh: 存成 .drawio（纯文本 XML）或导出图片

steps.en: Exports by rendering with its own bundled Chromium — no server compiles the diagram
steps.zh: 导出用自带 Chromium 本地渲染，不经过服务器

value.en: You get an editable, git-diffable diagram file that renders entirely offline — and no diagram data leaves your machine
value.zh: 拿到一份可编辑、可 diff 的图文件，全程离线渲染，图数据不外传
